purpose: Operational regime definitions. 'Trend' must be a measurable state, not an opinion. Every threshold here is computed from data, never assigned by the model.
computed_by: engine/features (deterministic code). The LLM may read the label; it may not invent it.

regimes.label: Uptrend
regimes.note: Buying strength in an uptrend is the whole point. Fading strength here is the mistake.

regimes.label: Downtrend
regimes.note: Long-only system: no setups in trend_down. Short selling is out of scope for Phase 1.

regimes.label: Range / Chop

any_of: ATR(14) below its 40th percentile over 60 sessions

regimes.note: Most indicators fail here. The regime label exists mainly to STOP trend setups from firing.

regimes.label: Transition / Unclear
regimes.note: A volatility shock is not a trend. Treat as transition until the shock resolves.

regimes.label: Unknown / Insufficient Data

any_of: data gap larger than 5 sessions in the last 60

regimes.note: No trade is a valid output. This label must never be silently upgraded to a tradeable regime.

market_wide_filter.effect: Halve position size. Do not disable signals -- a filter that turns signals off during stress also removes the recovery trades.
